top5.title: Nvidia Suspends Server Shipments to Southeast Asia
top5.description: Nvidia reportedly asked server manufacturers to halt deliveries to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia after new U.S. export rules took effect. Fitch expects slower growth and more selective investment in the region’s data centers.
top5.why: Nvidia’s reported halt to server shipments across Southeast Asia signals that tighter U.S. export controls are already disrupting data-center investment and the regional AI supply chain.

top5.title: SAP considers cutting 10,000 jobs in AI-related restructuring
top5.description: SAP is considering eliminating at least 10,000 positions, or about 9% of its global workforce, as part of a shift toward artificial intelligence. No final plan has been decided, and discussions with employee representatives are ongoing.
top5.why: SAP’s potential elimination of 10,000 jobs shows how major software companies are restructuring their workforces and operating models around AI adoption.

top5.title: Soaring memory prices push companies to open “war rooms”
top5.description: The global shortage of memory chips is leading small companies in particular to create purchasing teams to search for DRAM, sometimes on eBay. Prices have risen 500%, while manufacturers are prioritizing HBM memory for AI.
top5.why: Memory prices reportedly rising as much as 500% could materially increase costs and constrain production across the electronics and AI infrastructure industries.

top5.title: Switzerland confirms the first cyberattacks by AI agents against infrastructure
top5.description: Switzerland has confirmed the first cyberattacks carried out by artificial intelligence agents against critical infrastructure.
top5.why: Confirmed AI-agent attacks against critical infrastructure mark a significant escalation in cyber risk for governments, utilities and other essential operators.

top5.title: 42 Attorneys General Oppose the Sale of Character.AI Conversations
top5.description: A bipartisan coalition of 42 U.S. attorneys general is trying to block the planned sale of conversation histories from more than 21 million accounts. It criticizes the lack of safeguards allowing users to delete data or requiring buyers to follow privacy policies.
top5.why: The bipartisan effort by 42 U.S. attorneys general to block the sale of Character.AI conversations could establish important precedents for ownership, deletion and privacy rights over AI-generated user data.
